node.title: list corridor ledger
node.statement: The list-side assembly: per clean rate, the available eaters (planted-arithmetic pinning, census windows, any list analogue of the second-order term) recover >= W_list(rate) - 1 grid steps — collapsing the list bracket to adjacency. Exhaustive over the three rates; becomes list_adjacency_closing's implication packet. Evidence-gated on list_corridor_widths.
node.falsifier: a rate whose list eaters cannot reach W_list - 1
node.notes: PROVED on replay (Codex assembly packet, verifier PASS): the scale-free floor covers W_list - 1 at all three clean rates with exact-rational gains (81/128, 203/2048, 3/8); margins +0.0203 / +0.0240 / +0.0467. THE LIST CORRIDOR FAMILY CLOSES by the same mechanism as the mca family — the floor is list-native (it constructs the list).
